items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: he started to write for that band

ctx.x: And I didn't think that he'd be available. So, Johnny Thompson was his name and he was getting married and he was going to California on his honeymoon and suddenly he read in one of the trade magazines that I was forming a band, so they changed their mind and came to New York. And walked in this first day of rehearsal, I nearly fell over. And, he started to write for that band. So, Eddie did a few things; Alec Wilder did a couple of things --
Yeah, I was going go -- to ask you.
